title: Episode #20 – Positive Divorce Through Mediation | Interview With Top 1.5% Divorce & Beyond Podcast Host Susan Guthrie
metaDesc: Podcast: mediator and Divorce & Beyond host Susan Guthrie on positive divorce through mediation — and how online mediation changes the process.
bodyHtml:
Episode #20 – Positive Divorce Through Mediation | Interview With Top 1.5% Divorce & Beyond Podcast Host Susan Guthrie

Welcome to the show everybody!

Today’s guest is an award winning podcast host, online mediation expert, and veteran attorney who’s devoted her career to training peacemakers in the art and science of mediation to thousands of people nationwide. She’s the Co-Founder of Mosten Guthrie Academy, a mediation training academy, Founder and Principal of Learn to Mediate Online, a training program for mediators interested in learning to mediate online, and host of the award winning Divorce & Beyond Podcast, a show devoted to helping people going through divorce make it to the other side as a better, stronger, and healthier version of themselves.
